notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §9.1 rule 3, §14.5; F85, review A probes P5c, review B medium-2): a device declaration naming fix6-owner as its owner is self-signed with ed25519 and carries no owner cosignature. The owner's only declaration is cosigned by human-1, so the owner resolves: the missing owner cosignature is E_KEY_DECLARED_NOT_COSIGNED (invalid).
